cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era workshop beside a smithy — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a Korean jjimjilbang hall with heated floors and sleeping mats — dries her hair with a towel; the open deck of a wooden sightseeing boat on the Yangtze — standing; the back seat of a taxi at night — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; a club powder room with a lit mirror and neon on the tiles — touches one ear cup of a pair of over-ear headphones hung around her neck; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — standing; a candlelit gala dinner hall — holds a cup in both hands; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — checks the photo on the back screen of a camera at chest height; a mossy path under ancient oaks with shafts of light — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing with one foot up on a step; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — standing
